answer: Propose one vote/week per ID: lock 100 tokens for seven days and calibrate a crystal sensor for assays of reef water or nectar. Validators admit only disjoint ledger locks and check lab-signed ID/week receipts. Missing or invalid receipts deny the vote and slash 10 tokens; remaining stake unlocks on day 7. Labs can fake service; rich owners can fund many IDs. Service expense recurs; stake has a liquidity cost. Shared sensors and parallel agents cannot reuse locks or receipts: ten concurrent IDs require 1,000 tokens locked for a week.
